consent.title: Before we start
consent.body: FitCoach coaches you with AI. A few important points:

about.title: Let’s get to know you
about.body: Your coach tailors everything to you.

body.title: Your measurements
body.body: Used to set your loads and track progress.

level.title: Your level
level.body: Be honest: starting at the right level is faster.

goals.title: Your goal
goals.body: One main goal and up to 3 secondary ones.

schedule.title: Your schedule
schedule.body: How many sessions can you really keep up?

equipment.title: Your equipment
equipment.body: Tick everything you have access to.

health.title: Injuries and health
health.body: So we avoid risky movements. This stays private.

consent.disclaimer: FitCoach programs and advice are generated by AI and do not replace a doctor or health professional. See a doctor before starting if you have any doubt about your health. Stop immediately if you feel sharp pain, dizziness or chest pain.
consent.healthCheckbox: I understand FitCoach does not provide medical advice and I train at my own risk.
consent.gdpr: Your data (profile, sessions, measurements, photos) is stored securely and only used for your coaching. A summary is sent to our AI provider (Anthropic) to generate your programs. You can export or delete all your data at any time in Settings.
consent.gdprCheckbox: I consent to my data, including health data, being processed for my coaching.

fields.experiencePlaceholder: E.g. 2 years of gym, stopped 6 months ago

warnings.minor: You are under 18: get a parent’s permission and a doctor’s advice before starting.
warnings.medical: With these situations, ask your doctor before starting. Your coach will stay cautious.
warnings.sixDaysBeginner: 6 days a week is a lot for a beginner: 3 to 4 sessions are enough to progress.

levelDesc.beginner: Less than 6 months of regular training
levelDesc.intermediate: 6 months to 2 years, I know the basic lifts
levelDesc.advanced: More than 2 years, I track my loads and progress

errors.ageMin: FitCoach is for ages 13 and up.
errors.gdprConsent: Your consent is required to use coaching.
